issue.title: chore(deps): update dotenv-expand to v13
issue.body:
## Summary

**What**: `dotenv-expand` 11.0.7 to 13.0.0 in `@medusajs/utils`.

**Why**: Dependency update. Pinned to 13.x instead of 1000.0.0: 1000.0.0 runs any `$(...)` in a `.env` value as a shell command during `loadEnv` (and decrypts `encrypted:` values), with no option to turn it off. On a patch upgrade, a project whose `.env` holds a literal `$(` (for example in a password) would get a different value or run a command at boot.

**How**: Range bump `^11.0.6` to `^13.0.0`. No code changes: `expand()` keeps the same signature and return type. 13.0.0 depends on `dotenv@^17`, so the transitive `dotenv@16` is replaced by `dotenv@17.4.2` in `yarn.lock`.

**Testing**:
- `yarn workspace @medusajs/utils build`: passes
- `yarn workspace @medusajs/utils test`: 615 passed, 1 skipped
- Ran `loadEnv` against the same `.env` with 11.0.7 and 13.0.0. `${VAR}`, `${VAR:-default}`, references to shell-set variables, unquoted `$word` and `$(...)` (kept as literal text) produce identical results.
- Checked the `DB_NAME` / `DATABASE_URL=...$DB_NAME` setup written by `create-medusa-app` and `medusa db:create`: `DATABASE_URL` resolves the same on 11.0.7 and 13.0.0 with `DB_NAME` above or below `DATABASE_URL`, overridden in `.env.test`, or set in the shell.

| Package | From | To | Change | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| dotenv-expand | 11.0.7 | 13.0.0 | range | Expansion rewrite (12.0.0), dotenv 17 (13.0.0); no effect found on `loadEnv` |

### Breaking changes and call sites

Only call site: `packages/core/utils/src/common/load-env.ts` (`expand(dotenv.config(...))`).

- **No `process.env` self-expansion (12.0.0):** values already in `process.env` are no longer expanded. References from `.env` to shell-set variables still resolve (verified).
- **Expansion logic rewritten to match dotenvx, alternate value expansion added (12.0.0):** no difference found for the patterns above.
- **dotenv 17 (13.0.0):** only used internally by dotenv-expand; `loadEnv` calls the `dotenv@18` that `@medusajs/utils` already declares.

---

## Checklist

- [x] I have added a **changeset** for this PR
- [x] The changes are covered by relevant **tests**
- [x] I have verified the code works as intended locally
- [ ] I have linked the related issue(s) if applicable
